test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/627fb7563aa574769f01aff01e05c1de59b3f15674bcf6d4edffcf25eb555798.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first column and first row element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second element from second column and third column elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7729de1b46e0e02c5b34234da684ad801a29f165c7be71ea09da65f8f54661ab.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first row and third row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately third element from second row is replaced by new element i.e 'P' is replaced by 'L' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0cc16a1eaecde39d9d9de333a9547d02ca20373c669cea3e83e316e48407d71.png] ' is replaced by 'S'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82363b528c1740f8d64ba7bb1bd0bdc7b64c289904e1ab16233cfd1d10cd6443.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3406b9683b9af3ab8b616fc802fb3c5a5e81b07103452a3d8d5ef214a0a9ddb0.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
